tools.name: global-employment_uk-statutory-notice-period
tools.description: Calculate the minimum statutory employer notice period in Great Britain from continuous employment dates, and compare it with caller-supplied contractual notice. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/global-employment/uk-statutory-notice-period. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not ru

tools.name: global-employment_uk-statutory-redundancy-pay
tools.description: Calculate Great Britain statutory redundancy pay from age, service, redundancy date, and weekly pay using the 2026 cap and 20-year service limit. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/global-employment/uk-statutory-redundancy-pay. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: global-employment_uk-working-time-check
tools.description: Check caller-supplied shifts against UK 48-hour average, under-18 limits, 20-minute breaks, daily rest, and weekly or fortnightly rest rules. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/global-employment/uk-working-time-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: global-employment_us-overtime-calculate
tools.description: Calculate federal FLSA weekly overtime, or California daily, seventh-day, and weekly overtime, from one caller-supplied workweek. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/global-employment/us-overtime-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: global-employment_gender-pay-gap-calc
tools.description: Compute UK gender pay gap mean, median, bonus, bonus proportion, quartile, headcount, and reporting-threshold figures from caller-supplied employee-level data. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/global-employment/gender-pay-gap-calc. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "global-employment" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: global-employment_uk-working-time-check · Public sink: global-employment_uk-statutory-notice-period, global-employment_uk-statutory-redundancy-pay, global-employment_uk-working-time-check, global-employment_us-overtime-calculate, global-employment_gender-pay-gap-calc · Destructive: global-employment_uk-statutory-notice-period, global-employment_uk-statutory-redundancy-pay, global-employment_uk-working-time-check, global-employment_us-overtime-calculate, global-employment_gender-pay-gap-calc.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: global-employment_uk-working-time-check · Public sink: global-employment_uk-statutory-notice-period, global-employment_uk-statutory-redundancy-pay, global-employment_uk-working-time-check, global-employment_us-overtime-calculate, global-employment_gender-pay-gap-calc · Destructive: global-employment_uk-statutory-notice-period, global-employment_uk-statutory-redundancy-pay, global-employment_uk-working-time-check, global-employment_us-overtime-calculate, global-employment_gender-pay-gap-calc

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
